crossRefs.note: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.
His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.
The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan. The whole land trembles at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones…

translations.web: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.
translations.bsb: Do you make him leap like a locust, striking terror with his proud snorting?
translations.kjv: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
translations.asv: Hast thou made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is terrible.
